leaf: none — a process claim protecting the machine-readable artifact of every leaf
conditions: No physics is computed. Units unchanged and untouched: nm, pN, pN/nm, pN/nm^2 = 1 MPa exactly, k_BT = 4.141947 pN nm at 300 K, aqueous buffer with stated Mg2+. The corpus is gpd/results/ at HEAD of iteration 36 plus this iteration's edits; the baseline every diff is taken against is read out of git rather than out of the working tree.
verificationType: logical — a shape census over the committed corpus, an exhaustive shortest-round-trip test of every hit, a mutation measurement over the predicate in both directions, and 29 named checker + 15 emitter self-tests — plus in-silico: one study re-run through one snapshot and diffed field by field against its committed version

findings: THE SERIALISATION BOUNDARY CANNOT BE THE CURE, AND THAT IS THE STRUCTURAL DIFFERENCE FROM EVERY EARLIER MEMBER OF THIS FAMILY. C-0138 moved the departure rule into the one layer every study goes through, because the boundary sees a NUMBER. Here it sees a SENTENCE: by the time roundedForResult is called the Double is gone, and re-parsing decimals back out of a study's own prose would rewrite a cited literal as readily as a computed one. So the cure is necessarily per CALL SITE, and the only thing that can keep it closed is a census.

THE SHAPE REACHES 48 OF 144 COMMITTED RESULT FILES, NOT ONE. 757 tokens in 706 string fields at 175 distinct emission sites, of which C-0150 saw three. The queue row priced this task as one lattice solve plus a census; the solve is one file and the census is the deliverable, exactly as the row said — and what the census found is that the class is 250x the instance that raised it.

THE FALSE-POSITIVE RATE IS MEASURED EXHAUSTIVELY RATHER THAN SAMPLED, AND THE INSTRUMENT IS THE SHORTEST-ROUND-TRIP PROPERTY. Double.toString emits the shortest decimal that round-trips, and so does Python's repr; a token carrying more digits than that is not a toString output. All 748 of the corpus's hits satisfy it, so every one is an interpolated Double and none is a transcribed literature value. That is a proof over the whole population, and it cost one pass.

THE CHECKER'S OWN FIRST DRAFT HAD THE BLIND SPOT ITS THIRD NAMED TEST NOW HOLDS OPEN. Written with the symmetric trailing guard refusing a word char OR A DOT — the mirror of the leading one — it refused any number followed by a full stop, i.e. every number at the END of a sentence, in a corpus whose defects live in findings and outcomes. It cost 1 token(s) here and it could have cost far more in a corpus that punctuates differently. CLAUDE.md already records this for check-corpus-links.py and check-kotlin-format-strings.py: a checker's blind spot is invisible in exactly the cases it misses.

IT IS AN AUDIT AND NOT A GATE, AND THE GROUND IS ARITHMETIC. C-0083's rule is that a gate that cannot come clean is not a gate, and the corpus reads 748 in 48. The residue's cost is read out of the runbook rather than guessed: 38 of 47 affected files are in it, 8 carry a stated runtime and those alone sum to 161 minutes, and the set carries 39 dependency constraints — so the sweep is a topological sort over several iterations, not a tidy-up.

A PATH IS NOT A BASENAME, AND tools/reemission-order.py WAS SILENT ABOUT IT. Asked for the order of the 47 affected files by PATH it reported 0 dependency constraints; asked by basename it reports 39. tag_of split on '-' without taking a basename first, so 'gpd/results/T-108-...' became the tag 'gpd/results/T-108', which matches nothing in the census — and an unknown tag is deliberately 'placed rather than lost', so the wrong answer is indistinguishable from a set with no constraints. Repaired with two named self-tests. It is C-0117's own failure mode reached through the tool's input.

THE FILE DID NOT ONLY FAIL TO REPRODUCE, IT CONTRADICTED ITSELF. T-164's numeric sweep[0].bestDishingOverStroke is 0.0651753854 and the sentence beside it said 0.06517538540278571 — one quantity at two precisions in one file, one of which no field of the file states. A reproducibility rule and a self-consistency rule are the same rule here, and only the first of them was ever stated.
decision: The shape is a corpus-wide class: 757 tokens in 706 string fields at 175 emission sites in 47 of 141 committed result files, all of them interpolated Doubles by an exhaustive test. T-164 is repaired at its eleven call sites and re-emitted, moving 10 prose fields and 0 numeric ones. The census ships as the fourth line of tools/check-result-file-hygiene.py, as an AUDIT rather than a gate, and the corpus sweep that would let it become a gate is queued with the cost this task measured.
